messages:
laura: Quick heads-up — I'm going to trial a per-route opt-in for v1->v2 fallback on a small cohort of noisy tenants. Aim: reduce immediate error spikes during v2 rollout and gather per-route telemetry. TL;DR: opt-in flag + quota smoothing + sampled traces. Thoughts?

 dmitri: Which cohort? how are you defining 'noisy tenants'?

 laura: Starting with top 10 tenants by QPS that hit >95th p95 error during last v2 rollout. I have the list and reasons in the doc I'm about to post. Also enabling a 'soft-penalty' quota smoothing window to avoid sudden throttles.

 ben: @laura can we make the opt-in sticky per-tenant rather than per-request? sticky per-tenant seems safer.

 laura: Plan is per-tenant sticky with TTL 30d. If they opt-out we'll honor it. We'll surface an indicator in the console.

 sarah: For telemetry we should tag traces with `route_version=handback` and include `optin_source` (auto/probe/console). Also sample ~1% full payloads for quality checks.

 ops-bot: deploy-start laura/optin-per-route v1->v2 fallback probe (cohort=test-10) :rocket: 

 marta: Console UX note — need a toggle + timeline panel showing when opt-in applied and why. Also add a small badge on the route dashboard that says "fallback enabled" with hover text.

 laura: Mock for the UI: `Route settings -> Versioning -> Fallback opt-in [ON/OFF] (sticky, TTL 30d)`. I'll attach a screenshot once I upload.

 dmitri: Quota smoothing details? numbers?

 laura: Config sketch:
```
smoothing_window: 5m
max_delta_per_minute: 10%
grace_tokens: 5000
```
We'll start conservative and iterate.

 ben: Also add an alert if >2% of requests for a route use fallback for >15m. That could indicate a v2 regression rather than acceptable noise.

 sarah: Agree — add metric `fallback_rate_per_route` and wire an SLO alert to oncall. Also emit `fallback_reason` tag (auto, rate-limit, compatibility) so we can triage quickly.

 console-bot: task-created: Console ticket #INFR-2896 "Per-route fallback toggle + timeline" assigned to marta

 laura: I'll open PRs for telemetry tags + quota config and ping infra for a canary. Plan: enable for cohort at 09:00 PST tomorrow, monitor for 4 hours, then expand if stable.

 dmitri: Can we add an automated rollback: if route_error_rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m then auto-disable opt-in? Prefer automated safety.

 laura: Yes — adding circuit-breaker rule: auto-disable opt-in if route_error_rate > 1.5x baseline sustained for 10m, and post a console notification.

 marta: I'll mock the UI and post before EOD.

 ben: :thumbsup: lgtm. Put the telemetry into bigquery and add a dashboard widget for fallback_rate_per_route.

 laura: Thanks all. I'll update this thread with cohort list + PR links and the mock.
